## Load Data from MET API and Initailize pyspark DataFrame
```{python}
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os
import requests
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

# Load API key
load_dotenv()
api_key = os.getenv("MET_API_KEY")

# Call API
response = requests.get(
    "https://met-employability-services.azurewebsites.net/api/data/",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
)
print(response.status_code)
data = response.json()

# PySpark
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("MET").getOrCreate()
df = spark.createDataFrame(data)
df.toPandas().head(5)
